lines: Let's take a photo together, with this nostalgic scenery.
I want you to strike the same pose as that day and act goofy.
The blue sky above us, and whimsically drifting clouds.
Things that are beautiful are beautiful because they are far away.
Just as we promised, with you.
I'm really glad I could come here.
If this swelling feeling isn’t love,
I wouldn’t even know what love is.
A bouquet, filled with love.
It’s exaggerated, but please accept it.
Don’t ask me for a reason.
Just for now, forget everything.
Don’t laugh, just take it in.
Don’t be shy.
Today feels a lot like yesterday.
A casual crossroads,
I understood but failed to choose.
It’s because I’m cowardly.
I’m good at crying.
From the start I was counting on consolation.
I kept picking the wrong road over and over.
But I’ve come back here the right way.
Beyond the turning cycles of time,
always toward you,
this heart dances back.
Longing beyond a forced ideal.
Today, laughing together, is far happier.
Violet, indigo, black and blue
Flame, yellow, purple, sky blue
Pink, yellow, green, ash, brown
What colors shall I give you?
Beyond the turning cycles of time,
always toward you, this heart dances back.
I couldn’t even say thank you, I was being spoiled.
Until today, before coming here,
A bouquet, filled with love.
It’s exaggerated, but please accept it.
Don’t ask me for a reason.
Just for now, forget everything.
Don’t laugh, take it in—my true self.
Stay by my side forever.
